objective: Profile PIT-safe derived-event transform distributions and sign transitions before assigning any feature-specific deterioration or favorable semantics.
distribution_rules: Summarize symmetric_change only for cross-company distribution comparisons because it is bounded and scale-independent.
Do not aggregate absolute_delta across companies into a common magnitude statistic because raw units/scales differ by feature and filer.
Report deterministic p01, p05, p25, p50, p75, p95, p99 quantiles.
Report exact +/-2 saturation counts separately because sign crossings and zero transitions can sit at the symmetric-change boundary.
Keep CONSOLIDATED and STANDALONE visible as separate breakdowns.
forbidden: No feature weights or composite scores.
No model training, fitting, threshold optimization, or production promotion.
